purpose: Shared workflow routing policy for manual agent sessions and autonomous harnesses. This file chooses canonical repo skills; it does not duplicate skill procedure.

routeWhen: missing acceptance criteria for user-visible behavior
request uses broad words such as improve, clean up, optimize, support, or handle
grill-with-docs.autoLoopUse: Run as the default discovery gate. Resolve questions from repository docs/code first; stop for human input only when a product/domain decision remains unresolved.

expectedLoop: Restate the goal and identify missing decisions.
Inspect repository docs/code before asking the user.
Separate answers found from evidence, safe assumptions, and human-only decisions.
Stop with needs_human only when a product/domain decision remains unresolved.
Produce or update a task plan when unblocked.

diagnose.autoLoopUse: Use before editing when the task is failure-driven. The executor must reproduce or gather evidence before fixing.

expectedLoop: Reproduce the failure.
Gather evidence.
Identify the smallest causal explanation.
Fix only after the cause is understood.
Add or update a regression test where appropriate.

routeWhen: focused regression test can prove the change
tdd.autoLoopUse: Use for implementation tasks where a focused test or smoke check can prove behavior.

expectedLoop: Write or identify a focused failing test/check for the expected behavior.
Implement the smallest change that makes the test/check pass.
Refactor only after green.
Keep the validation focused and maintainable.

routeWhen: change crosses modules, packages, services, processes, or lifecycle phases
zoom-out.autoLoopUse: Use before selecting an implementation approach when context is missing.

expectedLoop: Inspect the surrounding system.
Map relevant files, ownership, dependencies, and data flow.
Only then choose the smallest necessary next change or follow-up task.

routeWhen: realistic chance to delete, collapse, or move code instead of adding another path
improve-codebase-architecture.autoLoopUse: Use for structural tasks, but still slice into small safe migration steps. Avoid broad rewrites.

expectedLoop: Understand the current architecture.
Identify the smallest useful seam or migration step.
Avoid broad rewrites.
Preserve behavior.
Document durable decisions only when they meet ADR criteria.

routeWhen: build, test, lint, run, deploy, debugging, or validation commands discovered or corrected
architecture map or module ownership clarified
PROJECT.md is missing, placeholder-only, stale, or contradictory
update-project-md.autoLoopUse: Use after durable repo facts change or are discovered. Do not store live task state in PROJECT.md.

expectedLoop: Inspect current repository evidence for durable facts.
Update PROJECT.md only with durable technical repo truth.
Do not store live task state, hypotheses, or conversation summaries.
Validate the documentation change against current code/docs where possible.

routeWhen: session or autonomous run must stop with context preserved
handoff.autoLoopUse: Use to produce a compact continuation note when the loop stops before completion.

expectedLoop: Summarize the goal, current state, evidence, and blocker.
List changed files, worktrees, validation, and verifier results.
Give the exact recommended continuation command or next human decision.

verifierRules: Check git diff against the selected task and acceptance criteria.
Check that the selected canonical skill was used or explicitly ruled out with evidence.
Check that configured validation commands passed or failures are explained as blockers.
Check that no unrelated files changed.
Check whether any human gate was crossed before allowing merge or completion.
